Pain.title: Sound familiar?
Pain.subtitle: Common headaches every CNC shop deals with when quoting

slow.title: Quoting takes hours
slow.desc: 1 quote means measuring volume, finding material, calculating CNC time, adding coating — 1-2 hr per part

nostandard.title: Inconsistent pricing
nostandard.desc: Each estimator does it differently — some forget setup, some miss coating → margin leaks

supplier.title: Calling suppliers for material prices
supplier.desc: Open the spreadsheet, call vendors, wait for callbacks — hours wasted just on raw-material rates

latenight.title: Working late to meet quote deadlines
latenight.desc: Customer sends drawings Friday afternoon, wants pricing Monday → your team works nights & weekends

office.title: Stuck waiting for office hours
office.desc: Customer emails a drawing at 11 PM — you can't respond because you have no material database or AI tools

lostdeal.title: Lost deals from slow replies
lostdeal.desc: Customer gets a quote from a competitor 2-3 days before yours → you've already lost the opportunity

Benefit.title: What you get with CNC Costify AI
Benefit.subtitle: Hours → Seconds. Manual → 90% AI-assisted.

fast.title: Done in 5 seconds per file
fast.desc: From 1-2 hr → 5 seconds = 100× more quotes per day. Reply instantly, close deals fast.

standard.title: One pricing standard across the team
standard.desc: Same formulas, material rates, coating rates for everyone. No more leaks from inconsistent calculations.

noCall.title: No more calling suppliers
noCall.desc: 100+ materials with density & pricing built in — pick, click, get the number.

always.title: Works 24/7 — no business-hour bottleneck
always.desc: Customer sends a drawing at 2 AM? Drag, drop, AI replies. Send back the quote within 5 minutes.

moreTime.title: Free up time for real work
moreTime.desc: Estimating that used to be 8 hr/day drops to 1-2 hr. Spend the rest on customers and process improvement.

winMore.title: Win more deals
winMore.desc: Faster than competitors = higher win rate. Customers will even pay a small premium for the instant response.

Preview.title: See the actual interface
Preview.subtitle: Designed to be dead simple — drag a file, pick the material, hit Calculate.

spot1.title: Auto volume + stock size from STEP files
spot1.desc: Drop a STEP/STP file — OpenCASCADE engine computes the real volume and stock-bar size in 5 seconds.
spot1.b3: ✓ Material + CNC + Setup + Coating on one screen

spot2.title: Analyze multiple drawings at once
spot2.desc: Batch-upload PDF/JPG drawings — AI extracts material, stock, coating, tolerance, holes for every file. Customer-ready summary table in seconds.
spot2.b2: ✓ Reads stock size / notes / coating specs
spot2.b3: ✓ Instant Excel export — table ready for your customer

spot3.title: Tune pricing, materials, and coatings
spot3.desc: 100+ materials database (editable), CNC formulas per difficulty, Coating/Surface/Wire-Cut rates dialed to your shop.
spot3.b2: ✓ Material DB 100+ — add/edit density and pricing

spot4.title: Ask AI about materials any time, 24/7
spot4.desc: Need to know corrosion resistance, density, or substitutes? Ask AI instantly with engineering-grade recommendations.

spot5.title: Export to Excel — edit, share, turn into a quote in seconds
spot5.desc: Every calculation auto-saves to your Excel file — one sheet per quote with technical notes, totals, and stock sizes. Send straight to your customer or sales team in your shop's standard format.
spot5.b1: ✓ Auto new sheet on every save — never overwrites previous quotes
spot5.b2: ✓ Pretty formatting + aligned numbers + highlighted totals
spot5.b3: ✓ Open in Excel and add margin, discount, VAT, or your logo — instantly turn it into a customer-facing quote

Features.title: Everything you need to price CNC parts in one place
Features.subtitle: Built for Thai CNC shops — easy, accurate, and saved automatically

step.title: Auto STEP File Analysis
step.desc: Upload .step / .stp — OpenCASCADE computes volume + stock size automatically. No manual measuring required.

pdfjpg.title: AI Reads PDF/JPG Drawings
pdfjpg.desc: Upload multiple PDF/JPG/PNG drawings at once. AI extracts Material, Stock Size, Coating, Tolerance, holes, etc.

calc.title: Auto Cost Calculation
calc.desc: Material + CNC + Setup + Coating + Surface + Wire Cut calculated using your shop's formula. Precision Base 1-20 levels.

excel.title: Save to Excel Instantly
excel.desc: Every calculation auto-saves to your Excel file in beautifully formatted sheets, with daily separation and highlighted totals.

ai.title: Multi-AI Engine
ai.desc: Gemini primary + OpenRouter (Qwen, GLM, Claude, Llama) auto-fallback when quota exhausted.

chat.title: Material AI Chat
chat.desc: Ask about Density, Material Spec, Hardening, Coating, Tolerance, Welding and more — answers in 2 seconds.
